definitions.gloss: full name; complete name including family name and given name
definitions.explanation: A person's complete name, as opposed to just their family name or given name alone. Used when specifying that the entire name is required.

examples.japanese: フルネーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧フルネーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: I don't know his full name.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申込書|もうしこみしょ}→申込書：03162_moushikomisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧フルネーム⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: You need to fill in your full name and address on the application form.

notes:
A wasei-eigo-style compound from English "full" + "name." While the component words are English, フルネーム is used naturally in Japanese and is well understood. In Japanese naming conventions, the full name consists of ⟦{姓|せい}→姓：15390_sei⟧ (family name) followed by {名|めい} (given name).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フルネーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write one's full name
- フルネーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to call someone by their full name
- フルネーム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill in one's full name
- フルネーム⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to search by full name

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{氏名|しめい}→氏名：04033_shimei⟧: full name — the formal/official term used on documents and forms
- ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧: name — can mean either full name or given name depending on context
- ⟦{本名|ほんみょう}→本名：13034_honmyou⟧: real name — as opposed to a stage name, pen name, or username
